review_cost.rationale: I'd approve after a small round of nits: signal-based filters, dependency hygiene, and a few extracted helpers in the Pokémon loader. Nothing needs structural rework.

findings.issue: go() reconstructs filter state by scraping the DOM (form.elements.namedItem('type')/('generation')) with silent fallbacks instead of tracking each select with a useSignal
findings.suggestion: Give the type and generation selects their own signals (or a single useStore of filters), and derive the navigation URL purely from state; delete the DOM reads and the fragile ?? fallbacks

findings.issue: The 150 ms debounce timeout is never cleared on unmount; navigating away mid-debounce still calls go() and navigates from a stale closure
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer in a useTask$ cleanup (useOnUnmount$/useCleanup or track-based cleanup), or guard the nav with a mounted check

findings.issue: Any non-OK upstream response throws out of the routeLoader and produces an unbranded 500 error page with no user-facing recovery
findings.suggestion: Catch fetch failures at the route level and render a friendly 'API unavailable' page with a retry link, at minimum for the five detail routes

findings.issue: Client component props (CardData) are typed by importing types from the server-only api module, blurring the server/client boundary the file's own header comment establishes
findings.suggestion: Move CardData/TypeInfo (and other shared view-model interfaces) into src/lib/types.ts and import them from both api.ts and the components

findings.issue: 'undici: *' is not referenced anywhere in src/, and 'typescript-plugin-css-modules' is pinned to 'latest' — both hurt reproducible builds
findings.suggestion: Remove undici (or justify it) and pin the plugin to a concrete version in devDependencies

findings.issue: One ~105-line routeLoader handles stats, evolution, version groups, move details and table assembly, with pervasive any casts on API responses
findings.suggestion: Extract move-table assembly and stats mapping into helpers in lib, and add minimal interfaces for the API resources (Pokemon, Species, Move) so the casts disappear

findings.issue: Changing the game select strips the URL hash (next.hash = '') and disables scroll, so the #moves anchor the user arrived via is lost silently
findings.suggestion: Preserve loc.url.hash when rebuilding the URL (or document why it is intentionally dropped)

summary: A clean, current-idiom Qwik City app on the stable 1.20.3 line: route loaders with proper 404 statuses, resolveValue heads, a catchall 404 route, and a well-bounded server cache — I'd merge it after one small round of nits. The main asks are replacing DOM-scraped filter state on the home page with signals, closing the debounce timer leak, and moving shared card types off the server-only api module. Everything else is dependency hygiene and extracting helpers from the dense Pokémon loader.
